segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ اَلْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ اَلسَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ اَلْأَرْضِ, وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ , أَهْلَ اَلثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ, أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ اَلْعَبْدُ ‏- وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ ‏- اَللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ, وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ, وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا اَلْجَدِّ مِنْكَ اَلْجَدُّ.

items.textEn: O Allah, our Lord, to You belongs all praise — as much as fills the heavens, the earth, and whatever else You will besides that. You are most worthy of praise and glory. The truest thing a servant can say is that all of us are Your servants. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the wealth of the rich avails nothing against You.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ لكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ ومَن فِيهِنَّ، ولَكَ الحَمْدُ لكَ مُلْكُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ ومَن فِيهِنَّ، ولَكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ ومَن فِيهِنَّ، ولَكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ والأرْضِ، ولَكَ الحَمْدُ أنْتَ الحَقُّ ووَعْدُكَ الحَقُّ، ولِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ، وقَوْلُكَ حَقٌّ، والجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، والنَّارُ حَقٌّ، والنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، ومُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللهُ عليه وسلَّمَ حَقٌّ، والسَّاعَةُ حَقٌّ، اللَّهُمَّ لكَ أسْلَمْتُ، وبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وإلَيْكَ أنَبْتُ، وبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وإلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ، فَاغْفِرْ لي ما قَدَّمْتُ وما أخَّرْتُ، وما أسْرَرْتُ وما أعْلَنْتُ، أنْتَ المُقَدِّمُ، وأَنْتَ المُؤَخِّرُ، لا إلَهَ إلَّا أنْتَ.

items.textEn:
O Allah, to You belongs all praise. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all within them. To You belongs all praise; to You belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all within them. To You belongs all praise; You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and all within them. To You belongs all praise; You are the King of the heavens and the earth. To You belongs all praise; You are the Truth, and Your promise is true, Your meeting is true, Your word is true, Paradise is true, Hellfire is true, the prophets are true, Muhammad ﷺ is true, and the Hour is true.
O Allah, to You I have submitted, in You I have believed, upon You I rely, to You I turn in repentance, with Your help I dispute, and to You I refer for judgment. Forgive me what I have done and what I have left undone, what I have concealed and what I have made known. You are the First and the Last. There is no deity except You.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ لكَ الحَمدُ كلُّه، اللَّهُمَّ لا قابِضَ لمَا بسَطْتَ، ولا باسِطَ لمَا قبَضْتَ، ولا هاديَ لمَن أضلَلْتَ، ولا مُضِلَّ لمَن هدَيْتَ، ولا مُعْطيَ لمَا منَعْتَ، ولا مانعَ لمَا أعطَيْتَ، ولا مُقرِّبَ لمَا بعَّدْتَ، ولا مُباعِدَ لما قرَّبْتَ.

items.textEn: O Allah, to You belongs all praise entirely. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold. None can guide whom You lead astray, and none can mislead whom You guide. None can withhold what You grant, and none can bring near what You have distanced, nor distance what You have brought near.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.

items.textEn: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the great Throne, our Lord and the Lord of everything, Splitter of the grain and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur’an, I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything that You hold by the forelock. O Allah, You are the First, there is nothing before You; You are the Last, there is nothing after You; You are the Most High, there is nothing above You; and You are the Most Near, there is nothing below You. Relieve us of debt and enrich us from poverty.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ أعُوذُ برِضَاكَ مِن سَخَطِكَ، وبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِن عُقُوبَتِكَ، وأَعُوذُ بكَ مِنْكَ لا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أنْتَ كما أثْنَيْتَ علَى نَفْسِكَ.

items.textEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your forgiveness from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. I cannot praise You enough; You are as You have praised Yourself.

segments.t: الحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ العالَمينَ، الرَّحمنِ الرَّحيمِ، مَالِكِ يَومِ الدِّينِ، لا إلهَ إلَّا اللهُ يفعَلُ ما يريدُ، اللَّهُمَّ أنت اللهُ لا إلهَ إلَّا أنت، أَنْتَ الغَنِيُّ ونحن الفُقَراءُ.

items.textEn: All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate, Master of the Day of Judgment. There is no deity except Allah; He does whatever He wills. O Allah, You are Allah, there is no deity except You. You are the Self-Sufficient, and we are the needy.

segments.t: الحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِيْ كَفَانِيْ وَآوَانِيْ، اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِيْ أَطْعَمَنِيْ وَسَقَانِيْ، اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِيْ مَنَّ عَلَيَّ فَأَفْضَلَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ أَنْ تُنَجِّيَنِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ.

items.textEn: All praise is for Allah who has sufficed me and given me shelter; all praise is for Allah who has fed me and given me drink; all praise is for Allah who has blessed me and favored me. O Allah, I ask You by Your might to save me from the Fire.

segments.t: الحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِيْ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يُطْعَمُ، مَنَّ عَلَيْنَا فَهَدَانَا وَأَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكُلَّ بَلَاءٍ حَسَنٍ أَبْلَانَا، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ غَيْرَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَّلَا مُكَافَأٍ وَّلَا مَكْفُوْرٍ وَّلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ أَطْعَمَ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ، وَسَقَى مِنَ الشَّرَابِ، وَكَسَا مِنَ الْعُرْيِ، وَهَدَى مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، وَبَصَّرَ مِنَ الْعَمَى، وَفَضَّلَ عَلَى كَثِيْرٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِهِ تَفْضِيْلًا، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ.

items.textEn: All praise is for Allah who feeds and is not fed; He has blessed us and guided us, fed us and given us drink, and granted us every good blessing. All praise is for Allah, who is never abandoned, never repaid, never denied, and never in need of others. All praise is for Allah who has given food to eat, drink to enjoy, clothes to cover our nakedness, guidance after misguidance, sight after blindness, and has favored us greatly over many of His creations. All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

segments.t: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ، وأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، ومَلائِكَتَكَ، وجَميْعَ خَلْقِكَ، أنَّكَ أنْتَ اللهُ لا إلَهَ إلاَّ أنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ، وأنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ ورَسُولُكَ.

items.textEn: O Allah, I bear witness to You, and I call to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah — there is no deity except You, alone without partner — and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.

segments.t: الحَمْدُ للهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيْرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيْهِ، كَمَا يُحِبُّ رَبُّنَا أَنْ يُحْمَدَ وَيَنْبَغِيْ لَهُ.

items.textEn: All praise is for Allah — abundant, pure, and blessed praise — as our Lord loves and as befits His majesty.
items.translit:
Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fihi;
Kama yuhibbu rabbuna an yuhmada wa yanbaghi lah.

segments.t: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وبحَمْدِه عَدَدَ خَلْقِه، ورِضا نَفْسِه، وزِنةَ عَرْشِه، ومِدادَ كَلِماتِه.

items.textEn: Glory and praise be to Allah — as numerous as His creation, as much as pleases Him, as heavy as His Throne, and as vast as the ink of His words.

segments.t: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوْتِ وَالْمَلَكُوْتِ والْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ.

items.textEn: Glory be to the Possessor of might, dominion, majesty, and greatness.
items.translit:
Subhana dhil-jabaruti wal-malakut;

Wal-kibriya’i wal-‘azamah.

segments.t: سُبحانَكَ اللَّهمَّ وبحَمدِكَ، وتبارَك اسمُكَ، وتعالى جَدُّكَ، ولا إلهَ غيرُكَ.

items.textEn: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise; blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no deity besides You.
Most Glorious, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
items.translit:
Subbuhun, Quddusun,

Rabbul-mala’ikati war-ruh.

segments.t: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً.

items.textEn: Allah is the Greatest, immensely so. All praise is for Allah in abundance, and glory be to Allah morning and evening.

segments.t: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ.

items.textEn: All praise is for Allah — abundant, pure, and blessed praise.
items.translit: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fihi.

segments.t: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ.

items.textEn: There is no deity except Allah, the Most Great, the Most Forbearing. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

segments.t: لاَ إلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ، وحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ له، له المُلْكُ وله الحَمْدُ، وهو علَى كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَدِيرٌ.

items.textEn: There is no deity except Allah, alone without partner. His is the dominion, and His is all praise, and He is over all things capable.

segments.t: لاَ إلهَ إلَّا اللهُ الواحدُ القهارُ، ربُّ السمواتِ والأرضِ وما بينهما العزيزُ الغَفَّارُ.

items.textEn: There is no deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing. Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving.

segments.t: سُبْحَانَ الْلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الْلَّهُ، وَالْلَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.

items.textEn: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no deity except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.

segments.t: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ.

items.textEn: Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah, the Most Great.
items.translit:
Subhanallahi wa bihamdih;

Subhanallahil-‘azim.

items.textEn: Glory be to Allah, the Most Great, and praise be to Him.
items.translit: Subhanallahil-‘azimi wa bihamdih.

items.textEn: Glory be to Allah, and all praise is for Allah.
items.translit:
Subhanallah;

Walhamdulillah.

items.textEn: Glory and praise be to Allah.
items.translit: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.

segments.t: الحَمْدُ للهِ حَمْدًا كثيرًا طيِّبًا مُّبَارَكًا فِيْهِ، مُبَارَكًا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ ربُّنا ويرْضى.

items.textEn: All praise is for Allah — abundant, pure, and blessed praise — blessed and pleasing as our Lord loves and is pleased with.
items.translit:
Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fihi;

Mubarakan ‘alayhi kama yuhibbu rabbuna wa yarda.
